title: Drag Performance Long Task Optimization
prompt: Optimize Design.tsx and elements.tsx to ensure no single browser task exceeds 50ms during drag with 180 nodes. The PerformanceObserver longtask test requires maxLongTaskDuration <= 50ms but currently sees ~4000ms max long tasks.
